responsibility: This file exists as the standalone compilation unit for GCC’s incremental hashing subsystem declared in inchash.h. It contributes no additional logic beyond including the portability headers needed to build the inline implementation, and serves to anchor the facility in the build so code using inchash can link consistently in both generator and compiler contexts.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/inchash.h, which contains the incremental hashing API and inline implementation, this source file is only a standalone compilation unit that includes the needed portability headers so the inchash facility has a build/link anchor in generator and compiler contexts.
